system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Workspace / git / `CLAWCODEX.md` injection; richer summaries and memory still evolving
system_prompt_style.note: Context system injects workspace/git/CLAWCODEX.md into prompt; MCP server instructions also injected.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Workspace / git / `CLAWCODEX.md` injection; richer summaries and memory still evolving
env_context_strategy.note: Context injection plus navigation tools Read, Glob, Grep.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the production compaction pipeline is wired and auto-compact actually applies its result

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Tool calling loop with streaming and headless mode

tool_count.note: README says '30+ tools' implemented; unclear how many are exposed by default.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: File Operations | Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep | ✅ Complete
edit_primitive.note: Write = whole file, Edit = string replace (Claude Code parity).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP | MCP tools and resources | 🟡 Tools wired; full client/runtime still evolving

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `clawcodex mcp serve` re-exposes ClawCodex tools as an MCP stdio server

loop_primitives.note: React loop default; plan mode and goal-judge loop reachable.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Task Management | TodoWrite, TaskManager, TaskStop | ✅ Complete

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agent Tools | Agent, Brief, Team | ✅ Complete
multi_agent_topology.note: Default single agent; coordinator/team mode and advisor are opt-in (advisor_enabled false by default).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: parallel Agent fan-out with the concurrency-cap deadlock fixed (#590)
delegation_mechanism.note: Agent tool spawns subagents; shipped by default in tool list.

human_in_loop.note: Interactive default is Full Access (no prompts); levels selectable via /permissions.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
For the six core abstractions (query loop, tools, tasks, two-tier state,
memory, hooks)

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: bounded persistent memory with a background self-improvement review (#731)

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a session sidebar that lists and resumes the **same durable sessions as the TUI**

self_verification.evidence_quote: the `/goal` + `/subgoal` completion-condition loop keeps the agent working until an LLM judge confirms the goal is actually met (#664)
self_verification.note: Advisor reviewer is off by default (advisor_enabled false).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: keeps the agent working until an LLM judge confirms the goal is actually met
retry_policy.note: Only within /goal mode; plain runs have no task-level retry. Transport retry lane separate.

rollback.evidence_quote: File Operations | Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep | ✅ Complete
rollback.note: No undo/revert tool listed in the tool registry; --worktree isolates runs in git worktrees.

cost_controls.evidence_quote:
ClawCodex keeps your request prefix **byte-stable**, so DeepSeek's prompt cache covers your whole
`system + tools + history` span across turns.
cost_controls.note: Routing via fusion models / model fallback; token budget via modelLimits + /eco compression.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Max time with **no content, reasoning, or tool-call delta**.
timeouts.note: Bash tool timeout distinguished from ESC-abort; no run-level wall clock documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the agent's Bash tool executes commands through Git Bash
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host; containers recommended only for --dangerously-skip-permissions.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: **Full Access** *(default)* | Edit any file and run any command without asking

permission_model.evidence_quote:
a repo can ship `.clawcodex/settings.json` (or `settings.local.json`) with a
`defaultMode` to *tighten* permissions
permission_model.note: Default interactive mode is Full Access (effectively none); allow/deny/ask rules, hooks with PreToolUse permissionDecision and an LLM security classifier make a rule engine.

tracing.evidence_quote: **Trajectory** is the same run as a metered ledger — every model request and tool call on a three-lane timeline with per-step tokens and timing

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
Fully reproducible from the
open-source [Harbor adapter](eval/harbor/)
eval_hooks.note: eval/ contains harbor and eco benchmarks plus SWE-bench workflow.

guardrails.evidence_quote: subprocess secret-scrubbing (#650), and a flag-gated LLM security-classifier lane for auto mode (#589)
guardrails.note: UserPromptSubmit hooks = input filters; PreToolUse permissionDecision = action policies.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A production-oriented Python rebuild of Claude Code — real architecture, reliable CLI agent
target_domain.note: WebFetch/WebSearch are retrieval tools, not browser automation.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: ClawCodex is dedicated to wiring in **all major LLM providers**

first_release_date.note: Basis: first 1.0 release of the coded line; earlier 0.x tags exist (v0.7.0 2026-06-30).
